classificationRules: Interactive complexity does not make a work a tool.
光譜、三晨星、策展集 are Dawn Bookshop selection standards, not tools or first-level surfaces.
Jerusalem 3000 belongs under 光譜 and must be treated according to that editorial relationship.
Media format does not create a public surface: sermon video belongs to sermon identity; cinema film belongs to Cinema programming.
A sparse surface receives a structural framework before layout, never invented filler content.
completionGate: Layout design may begin only after all seven surfaces pass the clarityTest and unresolved structural collisions are closed.
